resolutions.researcher_notes: Brief flagged the existing pair (sfegypt.com/4657, petro-news.com/95212) as DEAD_LINK, but both re-verify OK (200, expected Arabic content present) as of 2026-07-13 -- re-confirmed live, not actually dead. Kept sfegypt.com/4657 and swapped petro-news.com/95212 (a 39-project roundup with only a thin, operator-less mention of Baltim) for the more on-point, independent English-language Daily News Egypt piece (2019-08-27, 'First well of Baltim South West gas field to start production within days: Petrobel'), which states verbatim: 'Belayim Petroleum (Petrobel) completed the construction of 18 km-long, 26-inch-diameter offshore production line and 25 km-long, 26-inch-diameter onshore line ... three months ahead of schedule' and that the field's first well was about to enter production. sfegypt.com/4657 (Arabic, same date, 2019-08-27) independently corroborates: completion of the offshore + onshore lines and the offshore platform for Baltim field development. Corroborated further by Eni's own press release (eni.com, 2019-09) confirming the field went on-stream via 'a new 44 km long, 26 inch diameter pipeline' to Abu Madi Gas Plant, and by nsenergybusiness.com/offshore-technology.com field profiles -- all consistent with 'operating'. No contradiction found; the GEM value 'operating' is well-supported. Two independent origins (EN trade press + AR financial-news outlet), neither tracing to GEM or to each other -> tier high.
